Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You draw a bright line in front of your companion. As the blow approaches, the line spreads into a brief ward across its path.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing ally before an attack that will give the target a defense roll.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Trace a ward against this blow. Grant 1 Boon to the defense; no damage or resistance bonus is added.
